reference_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE category_id IS NULL) AS n_missing,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE category_id IS NULL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS share_missing
FROM products
alternatives: SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(category_id) AS n_missing, (COUNT(*) - COUNT(category_id)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS share_missing FROM products
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN category_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_missing, SUM(CASE WHEN category_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS share_missing FROM products

other_way.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(category_id) AS n_missing, (COUNT(*) - COUNT(category_id)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS share_missing FROM products
other_way.tradeoff: COUNT(category_id) skips missing values, so taking it from COUNT(*) needs no filter, but the FILTER says what it counts.
